notes: Parts 11-15 of the catch-up run: 50 groups processed into 77 rows. Merged groups (one row each): Agile Robots = "physical" + "softbank and nvidia back" + "softbank tse"; Genesis AI = "genesis" + "exclusive 2"; Q-CTRL = "q ctrl" + "q ctrl 2" + "salesforce stock"; LangChain = "langchain" + "this"; sennder = "german unicorn" + "freighttech unicorn"; Redalpine fund = "swiss vc redalpine" + "mistral and n26 backer"; ACWA Power = "acwa power stock 226" + "saudi acwa power"; Windward Bio = "sanofi backed windward bio" + "swiss biotech windward"; Indian weekly round-up = "indian startups" + "between november 02 and" (Instagram teaser, no extra facts). Round-ups expanded: Indian Startup News week of Nov 2-7 (22 rows; the table column is headed "Lead investor(s)" so listed names are recorded as leads; rows without their own date use 2026-11-07, Braid uses its 2026-10-29 press release date; KPN Ventures also backed Braid per the press release but is left out because no candidate text names it), crypto.news week of Nov 7-13 (13 rows; undated ones use 2026-11-13; DECA Labs' $12M is cumulative funding, not one round; vibe/vibe and Mori Finance are token sales), Techli Midwest week ending Nov 6 (6 rows; Ocient dated Nov 5, Erebor Bank dated Nov 2 from SBI's statement and it is a planned commitment; QualSights and CareLumi placed in Chicago by the article's four-of-six count). Judgment calls to review: VulcanForms $500M is recorded as Debt (press release only says "financing" led by J.P. Morgan and Apollo-managed funds; Dealroom calls it debt), so it falls out of scope, and its HQ follows Pulse 2.0's "Boston-based"; Agile Robots is dated 2026-11-12 (first coverage) although the PR Newswire APAC copy is dated Nov 17; Genesis AI is US under the dual-HQ rule (dateline "PARIS and SAN CARLOS, Calif."); Model ML stays GB (all coverage says London-based; no US dateline found); Science Corporation is is_ai_ml false after a lookup found no AI claim, with Alameda, CA from general knowledge; Zilch amount is the GBP 165M upsizing rather than the GBP 395M total; sennder's EUR 228M mixes EUR 73M equity and EUR 155M debt facilities so round_type is Other; Monzo is a talks-stage report (not-funding); Mentari, Windward Bio, Bird Construction, VICI, StandardAero, ACWA Power and MAIR Group are public-company rows; StandardAero, Viasat, LPL, Soros, UA Little Rock and Patrick Industries carry no funding amount. Web lookups used: 13 searches (Mentari, Science Corporation, Onodrim, sennder, Model ML, Bird, Erebor Bank, EloElo, Index Industries, Alta, Braid, Agile Robots date, VulcanForms instrument); URLs relied on are in source_urls, which means the validator skips its text check on those rows. Unresolved: HQ country for Mentari Therapeutics, Index Industries, BALI Treatment and most crypto round-up companies is "unknown"; Sand.ai investors are unknown (article blocked, title only).
